mentions.name: oxide
mentions.description: A Minecraft server implemented in Rust, built as a learning project. Already supports basics such as loading and saving worlds and placing/breaking blocks, with a first release and a public test server planned. Repo: https://github.com/T-x-T/oxide
mentions.source_excerpt: I’m currently working on implementing a Minecraft server in Rust. Not a new concept, I know, but it’s a great learning opportunity.
